description: This file defines the ScreenRecordService class responsible for capturing and recording the screen content using ReplayKit on iOS. It manages session configuration, sample handling, error management, and finalization of video and audio captures.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: A service class that manages screen recording sessions, handles video and audio sample buffers, and manages the lifecycle of a recording session including start, stop, and finalization.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A private generic struct wrapping a value to facilitate thread-safe access across concurrency boundaries.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: A private class maintaining the current state of a capture session, including references to AVAssetWriter, inputs, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: An enum representing possible errors during screen recording, including invalid screen index, capture failures, and write failures.

classes.name: RecordConfig
classes.description: A struct holding configuration parameters for a recording session, such as duration, fps, audio inclusion, and output URL.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main method to initiate a screen recording session with configurable parameters, manages the entire lifecycle including start, waiting, stop, and finalization, and returns the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Constructs a RecordConfig object based on input parameters, enforcing constraints such as screen index and clip duration.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Creates an output URL based on an optional path, defaulting to a temporary directory if none is provided.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins the ReplayKit capture session asynchronously with error handling.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler function for processing video and audio sample buffers during capture, ensuring thread-safe handling and invoking specific handlers based on buffer type.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes a video sample buffer, initializes the writer if necessary, and appends the sample to the video input.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Sets up the AVAssetWriter and its inputs for recording, configuring video and audio settings as needed.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes an audio sample buffer, appending it to the audio input if recording settings permit.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the ReplayKit capture session.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Completes the capture by finalizing the writer and checking for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Finalizes the AVAssetWriter asynchronously, handling potential errors.
